title: Jasmine Gomez
details: Poor little Jasmine Gomez. She's had a rough life. Her biological parents gave her up and her adopted parents don't approve of the whore life she's living. I can't say I blame them. Here they are, taking in some unwanted child and the piece of shit grows up to be a dirty filthy scumbag whore. Luck of the draw, I guess. Anyway, for those of you who are severely fucked in the head, this scene will work better than any Viagra pill would. It has everything... misery, puke, lost innocence and a hot chick. Honestly, I'm not sure I know how I'm going to sleep tonight. This one may give me nightmares... but they definitely won't be as terrible as the whore's.
